headline: Alpine Resort Logistics and High Peak Access
reservation: Ski lift tickets and equipment rentals should be secured via the official resort portal in advance. Accommodation within the valley is distinct from the town of Taos; winter visitors must verify mountain transit availability if not driving.

days.title: Alpine Acclimatization and Village Orientation
days.start: Suggested: 10:00 AM from the Village Base

stops.name: Rio Hondo Stream Walk
stops.detail: A gentle introductory path to stretch legs at 9,000 feet elevation.

stops.name: Village Base Area
stops.detail: Explore the B-Corp certified resort center and orient yourself with the lift systems.

days.driving: Minimal; local transfers or walking within the village.
days.note: Prioritize hydration and rest on day one to mitigate altitude symptoms.

days.title: Summit Challenges and Ridge Views

stops.name: Kachina Peak Lift
stops.detail: Ascend to over 12,000 feet for panoramic views spanning into Colorado.

stops.name: Wheeler Peak Wilderness
stops.detail: Access rugged trails bordering the resort for high-altitude wildlife viewing.

days.driving: Allow 15 minutes for internal valley shuttles; conditions vary.
days.note: Check wind speeds as lifts may close during high-velocity weather events.

days.title: Canyon Descent and Gateway Culture

stops.name: Arroyo Seco Village
stops.detail: Visit this artistic gateway community for local cafes and mountain crafts.

stops.name: Hondo Canyon Overlooks
stops.detail: Stop at designated pull-outs to view the granite walls of the canyon.

days.driving: Allow 1 hour round trip; steep grades require engine braking.
days.note: Winter driving requires snow tires or chains as mandated by local road conditions.

intel.title: Resort Lot Management
intel.text: Primary resort parking is tiered; arriving before 8:30 AM is recommended for closer access during ski season. Summer parking is generally available at the base.

intel.title: Village Connectivity
intel.text: WiFi is available in most lodges, but cellular service is non-existent in the deep Hondo Canyon approach. Reliable signal returns once you reach the mesa floor.

intel.title: Mountain Fuel Availability
intel.text: There are no gas stations within the Ski Valley itself. Refuel in the town of Taos or near the turn-off to Highway 150 before ascending.

intel.title: Seasonal Lift Operations
intel.text: Scenic summer lift hours are limited and usually end by 4:00 PM. Winter operations follow strict light and safety schedules; check daily mountain reports.

intel.title: Wilderness Boundary Rules
intel.text: Entry into the Wheeler Peak Wilderness from the resort requires adherence to Leave No Trace principles. Some high-altitude trails remain snow-blocked until late June.

plan.arrival: Rental pickup at TSM followed by a 70-minute canyon drive; check in and remain at the base to adjust to the 9,000+ foot elevation.
plan.vehicle: A 4WD or AWD vehicle is strongly advised for winter canyon travel; check local tire requirements before starting the climb.
plan.goldenHour: Kachina Peak for sunset views, accessible via lift in winter or strenuous hike in summer.
